title: Diplomacy Outside the League: Locarno and Kellogg-Briand
reason: None of the inaccuracies (the 'kiss in the wind' phrasing, generalizing that the three leaders shared the Nobel Peace Prize for Locarno, or the timing of the Ruhr troop withdrawal) are mark-affecting on a GCSE history exam.

pedantry.quote: France finally pulled its troops out of the Ruhr
Stresemann, Briand, and Chamberlain actually all shared the Nobel Peace Prize for it.
Critics at the time widely dismissed the pact as just 'a kiss in the wind'.
